name: Mitosis
author: Trance
description: A cell dividing under the microscope, over and over: the chromosomes line up across the middle, are drawn to either side, and the cell pinches into two, each time along a new axis. The cytoplasm streams round in slow currents, drawn faintly; the mids wobble the membrane and the cymbals make the chromosomes shiver.
frame:
cyc = beats/8
p = fract(cyc)
th = noise(floor(cyc)*3.7)*tau*2
sep = smoothstep(0.25, 0.85, p)
wob = 0.015*min(mid_att, 2)

layers.code:
s = (n*2 - 1)*sep*0.3
x = s*cos(th)
y = s*sin(th)
radius = 0.42 - 0.1*sep + wob*sin(time*3 + n*2)

side = n < count/2 ? -1 : 1
k = mod(n, count/2)/(count/2 - 1) - 0.5
d = side*(0.02 + 0.22*sep)
l = k*0.4*(1 - 0.4*sep)
x = d*cos(th) - l*sin(th) + 0.004*sin(time*60 + n)*treb_att
y = d*sin(th) + l*cos(th)
angle = th + n
